launch_decision.blocker: The paper equations identify h as the output width of each conceptual dense graph-convolution step, which is structurally represented by local DenseLayer growth_rate. However, the pinned released model shows only growth_rate=32 in its regression caller and does not expose the authors' Table S3 tuning invocation proving that the selected 64 was wired to this argument. Exact reproduction of the authors' tuned parameter-to-code binding therefore remains unverified. The local implementation does not make every physical GraphConv output h because it includes a 2x bottleneck. The paper's transition dimension notation also has an apparent indexing inconsistency.
launch_decision.required_resolution: Either obtain authoritative evidence linking the authors' Table S3 hidden-channel trial variable to growth_rate, or obtain explicit user approval to proceed with this disclosed local mapping as a project-specific interpretation. Then complete and record the effective runner configuration and remaining pre-run review before any study launch.

study.task: Davis training-only five-fold Optuna hyperparameter tuning
study.trial_count_basis: Project-selected initial budget; not specified by the paper and not claimed sufficient for search convergence.

sampler.basis: Project-selected reproducibility settings; the paper does not specify sampler or seed.

pruner.basis: Project-selected; no pruning policy is reported in the paper.

study.objective: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the five fold-best validation MSE values.
study.fixed_test_partition: Must not be loaded or consulted during tuning or model selection.

search_space.local_hidden_channel_mapping: Paper-level mapping supported by article Eqs. (1) and (3): hidden_channels is h, the output width of each conceptual dense graph-convolution step and thus the appended DenseLayer growth_rate. The pinned released implementation realizes each DenseLayer with an internal 2x bottleneck GraphConv followed by a growth_rate-width output GraphConv; the stem remains 32 and transitions halve block width. Therefore hidden_channels=64 does not mean every physical GraphConv emits 64 channels. Table S3 does not specify these implementation-internal widths.

max_epochs.basis: Project choice following the current local default; not specified by the paper.

steps_per_epoch.basis: Project choice following the current local default; not specified by the paper.
